seoDescription: Cococabana is a rooftop bar and restaurant in Downtown Oceanside, CA with coastal cocktails, weekend brunch with bottomless mimosas, ocean views, and private event space.
heroText: Rooftop drinks, brunch, coastal energy, and private events in Oceanside.

heroImage.alt: Cococabana rooftop bar aerial view over Downtown Oceanside, CA

welcome.imageAlt: Cococabana rooftop lounge seating with tile wall, rattan pendants, and Oceanside views
welcome.title: Where Oceanside
welcome.text:
Perched above The Brick Hotel at 408 Pier View Way, Coco Cabana is a
rooftop bar built around its own identity — relaxed, elevated, and entirely its own.
Stop in for a cocktail, settle in for the evening, or make it the start of a night
out in Downtown Oceanside.

bar.title:
Open Air. Full Bar.
Oceanside Rooftop Bar
bar.text: Coastal-inspired cocktails crafted from scratch, cold drafts, and a full bar program under open skies — four stories above Downtown Oceanside.

brunch.title:
Rooftop Brunch
Bottomless Mimosas, Oceanside

view.imageAlt: Sunset viewed from Cococabana rooftop through glass railing, palms silhouetted against orange sky
view.imagePosition: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover object-[center_65%]
view.title: The Rooftop View Above Oceanside
view.text: Four stories above Downtown Oceanside, the views stretch past the rooftops and palm canopy all the way to the Pacific. Sunsets here are something else entirely — settle in early and watch the sky change over the water.

cabana.imageAlt: Cococabana lounge area with open air,  geometric tile wall, and Oceanside city views
cabana.imagePosition: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover object-center
cabana.title: Rooftop Lounge Seating in Oceanside
cabana.text: The cabana's seating is designed for settling in. Rattan pendants overhead, geometric tile walls, and unobstructed views of the Oceanside skyline — this is the corner of the rooftop you'll want to claim early.

liveMusic.imageAlt: DJ set at Cococabana with crowd on the rooftop
liveMusic.title:
Oceanside Rooftop DJ Nights
Fridays & Saturdays
liveMusic.text: Live DJ sets every Friday and Saturday.  The rooftop transforms after dark — cocktails, open air, and the Oceanside skyline as your backdrop.
